text_solutions: The peripheral nervous system (PNS) consists of cranial and spinal nerves, which connect the CNS to the rest of the body.

qns_content.text: Which of the following is the main function of the neural system?

text_solutions: The neural system is responsible for coordinating and integrating various functions in the body, ensuring proper homeostasis.

qns_content.text: Which part of a neuron contains the nucleus and most of the cell's organelles?

text_solutions: The cell body (or soma) contains the nucleus and organelles, supporting neuron function.

qns_content.text: Which neurotransmitter is released at neuromuscular junctions to stimulate muscle contraction?

text_solutions: Acetylcholine is released at neuromuscular junctions to trigger muscle contraction.
